_comment: automation_authors.json — allowlist of PR authors the auto-dev merge loop may act on. The loop (FR-013) only monitors/merges PRs authored by automation. Any author NOT in this list is treated as human-authored and skipped — config-driven so adding a bot needs no code change. Match against `gh pr view --json author -q .author.login` (and the GraphQL `author.__typename == "Bot"` signal as a belt-and-suspenders check; see research.md R2). Logins are matched case-insensitively, with or without a trailing "[bot]" suffix, since the suffix is surface-dependent across the gh REST/GraphQL APIs. Mirrors the bootstrap install's YAML authors list (kept in the coordinator's own home config tree, outside this portable bundle) to avoid a YAML dependency here — keep both in sync by hand.
_authors_comment: RB-chrismandich / ReefBytes-Owner: the autonomous issue developer's own account. google-labs-jules / copilot-pull-request-reviewer / Copilot / coderabbitai: recognized bots that open PRs into this repo. forge / palette / bolt: persona/automation branches (matched on author login, not branch name).
_trust_bot_typename_comment: Treat any author whose GraphQL __typename is "Bot" as automation even if not listed above.
